queries.notes: Official 2026 XLSX (https://www3.scottcountyiowa.gov/treasurer/pub/tax_sale/2026/20260616_Tax_Sale_List.xlsx) was HTTP-403-blocked as of 2026-08-18 (see issue #16); confirmed 2026-08-19 that the block was bot-UA filtering, not real access control -- a normal browser User-Agent gets a clean 200 with a real 297-row workbook. Not yet safe to build a collector: the same Item Number recurs across multiple Year/Receipt rows (a running ledger, not one-row-per-certificate), real estate and mobile-home items are interleaved rather than sectioned, and the precomputed Sale Amount field is populated inconsistently across a given item's rows. Real owner names/addresses are in named columns and easy to exclude, that part is not the blocker. See issue #16 for full detail.

queries.notes: Fixed 2026-08-20 (BUG-008 in BUGS.md, closes issue #29): a PDF text-extraction artifact was splitting dollar amounts with a stray internal space (e.g. $348.00 extracted as '$ 3 48.00'), which broke the existing $20-fee safety check and silently dropped ~30% of rows (1100/1569). Fixed by collapsing the stray whitespace before parsing; recovered to the full 1569/1569 real-estate item range, verified against the live 2026 publication.

queries.next_action: See issue #35: item-identification key needs to become (district, item_number) or similar, since the county resets item numbering per district rather than counting continuously 1-576. Confirm the correct total item count under a per-district-aware read before rewriting the parser.
queries.notes: Found broken 2026-08-20 while fixing Woodbury (BUG-008 in BUGS.md) -- has never successfully published (0 rows, not a regression). Root cause: item numbers like '8)' and '9)' repeat 100+ times across the document (once per district), but the parser dedupes globally by raw item number, so it keeps only the first occurrence of each number and drops every later legitimate reuse -- extraction stops dead after item 9. Workaround shipped same day: added to blocked_zero_ok in both workflows' Verify step + continue-on-error on its refresh step, so this no longer blocks the shared daily pipeline the way it did before (see BUG-006's established pattern for Johnson/Linn).

queries.notes: Net-new state -- Montana was previously not_started in source-registry.json (26 -> 25 remaining). County publishes a rolling two-year 'Tax Lien Certificate Lists' HTML export (mislabeled .xls) plus a separate 'Additional Properties' list; merges and dedupes all three, tax_code+tax_year is NOT unique (a parcel can carry more than one certificate per year with different amounts), so record_id gets a numeric suffix when that happens. Total Due explicitly excludes accrued penalty/interest per the source's own column label -- flagged in fees_costs. Statutory 10%/yr interest (MCA 15-16-102) and 3-year redemption (MCA 15-18-111) confirmed against the official MCA text, not a secondary source. No owner names published (source provides a Name column; intentionally never extracted, matching BUG-004/BUG-005 convention). continue-on-error: true in refresh-properties.yml since this is day-zero.
